name: BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio: Historical Context
description: Tracks the BRL carry-to-vol ratio (Selic minus Fed Funds, divided by 63-day realized USDBRL volatility) over its full available history. Shows the ratio time series, a full-history expanding percentile rank, and a summary table with current value, mean, median, and key percentiles (25th, 75th, 90th). Selic proxy: Brazil Interbank Rate (IRSTCI01BRM156N, monthly). Fed Funds: DFF (daily). Vol: 63-day annualized realized vol on USDBRL close.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRL CARRY-TO-VOL RATIO: HISTORICAL CONTEXT
# =============================================================================
# Carry = Brazil Interbank Rate (Selic proxy) minus US Fed Funds Rate
# Vol   = 63-day annualized realized volatility on USDBRL (decimal → ×100 → %)
# Ratio = Carry (%) / Vol (%)
#
# Percentile rank uses full available history (expanding window via large period)
# Current reading ~1.09 per user
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
usdbrl = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()   # Brazil interbank (monthly)
fed_funds_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()               # US Fed Funds (daily)

# Forward-fill sparse rate data to daily frequency
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)    # monthly → daily
fed_funds = ffill(fed_funds_raw.result)  # daily (already dense, ffill for any gaps)

# --- Carry Differential ---
# Both series in % per annum (e.g., 13.75 for Selic at 13.75%)
carry_spread = brl_rate - fed_funds      # positive = BRL carry advantage

# --- Realized Volatility ---
# volatility() expects price levels, outputs annualized decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%)
# Multiply by 100 to convert to % units matching the rate differential
usdbrl_vol_pct = volatility(period=63)(usdbrl.c) * 100.0

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# Guard: only compute when vol is valid and positive (avoid div-by-zero)
carry_vol_ratio = where(
    is_valid(usdbrl_vol_pct) and usdbrl_vol_pct > 0.0 and is_valid(carry_spread),
    carry_spread / usdbrl_vol_pct
)

# --- Full-History Percentile Rank (expanding) ---
# period=5000 covers ~20 years of daily bars — effectively full history
# percentrank returns 0-100
pctrank = cs_rank_quantile(ascending=True)(carry_vol_ratio)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# 1. CONTEXT: Carry-to-Vol Ratio Time Series
xy_lines(
    title='BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio: Is the Carry Compensation Worth the FX Risk?',
    category='BRL Carry-to-Vol',
    order=1,
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol Ratio (Selic−Fed Funds / 63d Realized Vol)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero (no carry advantage)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='1.0 (carry = vol)', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.09, title='Current (~1.09)', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ])
)(x_values=index().value, y_values=carry_vol_ratio)

# 2. PUNCHLINE: Percentile Rank — Where Does 1.09 Sit in History?
xy_lines(
    title='Where Does the Current Ratio Sit vs Full History? (Percentile Rank)',
    category='BRL Carry-to-Vol',
    order=2,
    y_axis_label='Percentile Rank (0=lowest ever, 100=highest ever)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Percentile Rank', color=Color.Blue, area=True)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=75.0, to=100.0, color=Color.Green, label='Top Quartile', opacity=0.1),
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=25.0, color=Color.Red, label='Bottom Quartile', opacity=0.1)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, title='Median (50th)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=75.0, title='75th Pctile', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=90.0, title='90th Pctile', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(x_values=index().value, y_values=pctrank)

# 3. REFERENCE: Summary Table — Key Statistics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio: Historical Statistics',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Carry-to-Vol Ratio', 'Percentile Rank'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Mean', 'Median'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Carry-to-Vol Ratio
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Most recent carry-to-vol ratio reading'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Historical mean of carry-to-vol ratio'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Historical median of carry-to-vol ratio'),
            # Row 1: Percentile Rank
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Current percentile rank vs full history'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Mean percentile rank (should be ~50 by construction)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median percentile rank')
        ]
    ),
    category='BRL Carry-to-Vol',
    order=0
)(carry_vol_ratio, carry_vol_ratio, carry_vol_ratio, pctrank, pctrank, pctrank)
